system@link.description: Link to the system receiving the commands

inputName.description: Name of the system control input receiving data from this control stream

procedure@link.description: Server-provided link to the procedure shared by all commands in this control stream. Omitted when no common procedure can be represented.

deployment@link.description: Server-provided link to the deployment shared by all commands in this control stream. Omitted when no common deployment can be represented.

featureOfInterest@link.description: Server-provided link to the ultimate feature of interest shared by all commands in this control stream. Omitted when no common target can be represented.

samplingFeature@link.description: Server-provided link to the sampling feature shared by all commands in this control stream. Omitted when no common target can be represented.

controlledProperties.description: Server-derived descriptions of properties controllable through this control stream. `null` indicates that no common property list is available.

oneOf.description: List of properties that are controllable through this control stream

definition.description: Identifier for the controllable property, normally a resolvable URI.

label.description: Human-readable name of the controllable property.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the controllable property.

issueTime.description: Server-derived time extent spanning the issue times of commands in this control stream. `null` indicates that no extent is available.

oneOf.description: Time extent spanning all issue times of commands in this control stream

executionTime.description: Server-derived time extent spanning the execution times of commands in this control stream. `null` indicates that no extent is available.

oneOf.description: Time extent spanning all execution times of commands in this control stream

live.description: Whether this control stream accepts new commands.

async.description: Flag indicating if the command channel processes commands asynchronously

schema.description: Schema describing the content of commands in this control stream. The exact syntax of the schema depends on the encoding format.
